caption: The drawing displays a patterned textile or quilt design, divided mainly into two sections. On the left and central part, there are sixteen square segments arranged in a 4x4 grid, each segment containing a single blue flower with rounded petals, a pink and white center, and a yellow-green core. The background of these segments is a pale grayish tone with a grid pattern creating separation between the squares. On the right and lower borders, a band of repeating larger flowers with pink, scalloped petals and yellow-green centers runs along the edge. These pink flowers are connected by a green vine with many green leaves and curlings, with an occasional small yellow oval with a blue center interspersed between flowers. The edge band creates an L-shaped frame that covers the rightmost column and bottom row, forming the border of the design. The background outside the main patterned area is an off-white or light beige color.
title: Printed Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
